THE EXAMINATION, EXPLAINED

Papers & components.

Choose the year you will sit the exam. The weighting applies to the qualification and route selected below.

EXAMINATION YEAR 2027ROUTE Full A Level
Assessment components · 9093 · 2027 · Full A Level
ComponentDurationMarksWeighting
PAPER 1Reading2h 15m5025%
PAPER 2Writing2h5025%
PAPER 3Language Analysis2h 15m5025%
PAPER 4Language Topics2h 15m5025%

Full A Level comprises Papers 1–4, each worth 25%. AS Papers 1 and 2 may be carried forward under Cambridge’s rules, or all four papers may be taken in one series. All papers are externally assessed.

Reading — component 1+

Directed response: 25 marks (writing 10, comparison 15). Text analysis: 25 marks.

Writing — component 2+

Short writing and commentary: 25 marks (15 + 10). Extended writing: 25 marks.

Language Analysis — component 3+

Language change: 25 marks. Child language acquisition: 25 marks.

Language Topics — component 4+

English in the world: 25 marks. Language and the self: 25 marks.

A PURPOSE FOR EVERY LESSON

What you’ll work on.

01

Analysis with explanation

Connect a writer’s choices to audience, purpose and meaning.

02

Writing and commentary

03

Language in the world

Explore the concepts and evidence behind advanced language topics.
